text:
michelle: quick design review -> playground chat streaming. main asks: stop/regenerate affordance, token counter placement (compact vs wide), prompt library quick-insert. short mocks attached.

sam: make stop obvious when streaming. users need an immediate way to halt. :warning:

jorge: agree, but compact is tight. propose icon-only stop that expands on hover/focus for label.

alex: two patterns: inline trailing controls vs persistent footer toolbar. inline keeps context, footer is discoverable. compact token counter = icon badge with tap reveal.

katie: accessibility: stop must be tabbable right after message. aria-label="Stop streaming response". use live region announcements for start/stop. prompt lib modal must trap focus, role=dialog, aria-modal=true, shortcut Ctrl/Cmd+K.

michelle: copy: use "Stop streaming", "Regenerate response", "Retry" (retry = same request). prompt actions: "Insert and edit" / "Insert & send". token label: "tokens (response)".

sam: telemetry: track which stop control is used and insert+send frequency. A/B test placements.

jorge: contrast nit in dark mode for token badge; need 4.5:1 for small text.

figma-bot: New comment on frame "Playground/Stream compact v3": https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-stream-compact

michelle: decision: widescreen -> footer toolbar; compact -> inline icon-only stop + badge. action owners: alex update mocks, jorge contrast pass, katie write ARIA spec, sam add telemetry. scheduling 30m sync tomorrow. thanks! :tada:
